name: Events: delete
description: Deleting an event outright, for drafts that never sold. Anything with orders, tickets, reservations or payments must be cancelled instead (cancelling keeps the record and tells ticket holders); a published event is unpublished first (POST /v1/events/:id/unpublish). Needs `events:write`, and the key's creator must be an owner or manager.

endpoints.description: Deletes the event with its ticket types, schedule, notes and settings. 409 when it is published or has any order, ticket, reservation, payment or invoice: cancel it instead.

example.error: The event has orders, tickets or payments (tickets): cancel it instead

responses.description: The key's creator isn't an owner or manager now.

example.error: only a key created by an owner or manager can make or delete events

responses.description: No such id in your organization.
